title: 雪の町と冬の遊び(切り絵)
lead: 雪の町、スキー、雪だるまなど、冬の景色と遊びを切り絵のタッチで12点描きました。冬のチラシや案内に使えます。
subject_en: layered coloured-paper cut-out illustration: crisp scissor-cut edges, flat paper colours in navy, ice blue, red and warm cream, tiny paper-layer shadow only along edges, a closed darker outline made by a thin dark paper edge, no people faces shown in detail. Each item is a separate small subject centred in its cell with space around, never touching another. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates, clouds) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
items: a snowman with a scarf and a bucket hat
a pair of skis and poles crossed
a wooden sled on a snow slope
a small cottage with a snowy roof and lit window
knitted mittens and a bobble hat
icicles hanging from a roof edge
a small stove with a kettle
two small birds on a snowy branch
a row of three snow-covered houses under a night sky
